items.title: Demon Warriors
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Demons are taking over the city! Pick up some awesome and expertly designed fantasy demon warrior skins today! With great looking aesthetic armor, ninjas, and other unique legends in this awesome pack!

+ 20 skins
+ Colorful and bright
+ Modern skin designs

items.title: Skyblock Teens
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Skyblock is everyone's favorite game mode! Dress up in some fashionable, and comfy skins that are perfect to play your favorite game mode in. Inspired by the sky and the game mode itself, you'll find these skins are appropriately designed for a good fun time!

- 12 skins
- Colorful
- Modern attire
- Great for teens

items.title: Mega City: Police Pursuit
items.creator: Kreatik Studios
items.description:
Play in a 500x500 MEGA city world of custom models, furnished houses, police station, shops, office buildings and skyscrapers! Fast race cars, helicopters, bandit and police cars: they are all in here! Catch the bandits in the ultimate police pursuit and put them into jail! 

+ 200+ rooms to explore in the city
+ 25+ vehicles in many colors
+ Free skins

By Kreatik Studios

items.title: Aliens Skin Pack
items.creator: stonemasons
items.description:
Scare friends with awesome horror alien skins from outer space! Are these fuel for nightmares or dreams? You can go on cosmic adventures with these dream like creatures. Show the skin of your dreams to friends or revel in your safe place. Don't isolate yourself too much though.

- cthulhu
- alien man
- jelly man
- demon skeleton
- ogre

items.title: Knights vs Wizards
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
Knights vs Wizards! Who is going to win the ultimate contest?
Pick your side and let the battle begin!

+ 6 skins, perfect for any adventure!
+ 3 knights and 3 wizards, coming face to face and unleashing their special powers!
+ By Senior Studios & Daylight Studios!

items.title: Metals
items.creator: MobBlocks
items.description:
From copper to mythical mithral, your sure to find the metal you need in this fun skin pack.
One free skin!

items.title: Family Life
items.creator: MobBlocks
items.description:
Play with family with this family life skin pack. 
Perfect for those that like to role-play.
One free skin!

items.title: Anime Fashion Demons
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
New anime fashion demons are finally here! There's nothing to be scared of anymore, they are here to hunt down mobs and protect the town!

- 10 demonic anime skins included
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from Noel Design.

items.title: Mob Lawyers
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
All rise for Judge Cow! This is the perfect pack for some courtroom chaos! It includes everything you need for roleplay - a judge, some lawyers, and even a guard dog!

- Perfect for fun roleplay!
- Battle it out in the courts!
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from Zander Studios.

items.title: Neon Zombies
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description: Transform into a monster skin with vivid and vibrant shades. From the infinite world, all the way to the end. Protect and defend your realm to become the most glowing zombie Minecraft has ever seen!

items.title: Ender Drip
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description: Yo Ender drip-themed clothing! Show off your love for the Enderman! From the infinite world, all the way to the end. Protect and defend your realm to become the most dripped out character Minecraft has ever seen!

items.title: City of Atlantia
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description: Atlantia, also called the City of the Ancestors, is a City-island built by the Ancestors several thousand years ago. Atlantia is all that remains of the greatest community ever to inhabit the overworld.

items.title: Elite Of Demons
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
These demons are the best of the best! They possess unlimited strength and are the most feared in the spirit world! Climb to the top of the pecking order and unlock unknown levels of power!

- 12 skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: Witch Knights
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
These knights have magical powers! Combine your talents for spell casting and sword fighting and become a powerful knight!

- 12 skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: End Knights
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
The guard of End city is looking for new recruits to join their ranks! Do you have what it takes to become a knight and protect those who live there? Prove yourself and climb up the ranks!

-12 Knight skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: Hidden Manor
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Hidden behind the lush greenery of a forest lies a little castle awaiting the return of a righteous owner! A tranquil place perfect to unwind and relax! Will you be able to lay claim to the ownership of this gem of a castle?

- Small castle survival spawn
- A lot to explore
- By Rareloot

items.title: Porto Del Santros
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
The ultimate beach town awaits you! Roam through the alleys and fields! Discover everything it has to offer! Immerse yourself in a beautiful world and start your survival adventure!

- One of a kind survival spawn
- Fully furnished homes
- Highly detailed
- Secret chests
- By Team Ethyria

items.title: Netherplant D-34
items.creator: Shapescape
items.description:
Travel to the Nether and explore Netherplant D-34! This enormous nether plant is all yours! Do you expand it or fight the monsters inside? This plant can be your new survival home, but beware! Do not try to sleep here!

+ Perfect for roleplay
+ Perfect as a survival base
+ Multiplayer and single player!

items.title: Speed Bridge Challenge
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Time to master one of the most important skills in Minecraft. Want to become a pro bridge maker and win any PVP contest? Compete with up to 4 friends on each level or practice on your own. Improve your bridge building skills for sky wars, bed wars, skyblock, PvP arenas, and more.

+20 challenging levels
+Measure your bridging speed
+Full multiplayer support
+4 HD skins

items.title: Legend Squad
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Run, roll and join the squad! Be remembered for your actions and join the squad of legends. Together with your friends, you can keep the peace in the city while you combat the evil forces! Get ready for a new adventure with these skins. Don't miss this chance!

+ 1 free skin 
+ 12 legendary skins 
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Epic Teens
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Epic vibes all over the city! Welcome into a completely new dimension, while trying the out latest trends. These teens are setting new trends for the future! Shine bright like a star, meet new friends, and become the most popular youngster in all the lands. Let your free spirits shine through!

+ 1 free skin 
+ 12 epic skins 
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Mansion Bundle
items.creator: Kubo Studios
items.description:
Getting bored of your survival world? Time to own 6 MANSIONS! Choose from a variety of mansions to start your survival exploration, from LUXURY, MODERN, MEDIEVAL, FUTURISTIC, SUBURBAN, or a DIRT MANSION! 

+ 6 DIFFERENT MANSIONS!
+ SURVIVAL WORLD!
+ PLAY WITH FRIENDS! 

! Mansions only included on the world provided

items.title: Nether Monsters HD Skin Pack
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
Buried among the lava and rock lie scary monsters that have never been discovered! Some of these creatures resemble mobs, dragons, dinosaurs, and more. Be spooky and fiery on your next trip to the nether! Disclaimer: Does not make swimming in lava any easier.

+ 8 HD skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna

items.title: Viral Mobs Nether
items.creator: Team Metallurgy
items.description:
Nowhere is safe from the mob virus! The newest version of the mob virus is infecting as we speak and bringing along a fiery cast of new foes! Build your best base and prepare to block their attacks! 

- Includes 5 zombified monitor head skins!
- Roleplay a horror scenario and scare your friends!
